paite: Huan, TOUPAN Mosi a houpiha,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: Dangka pengkul nih bawl inla; sekthohin bawlin: mipite sap khawmna ding leh pawtsakna dinga na zat ding ahi.
english: “Make two trumpets of silver. You shall make them of beaten work. You shall use them for the calling of the congregation, and for the journeying of the camps.

paite: Huai a kimut chiangin mipi tengteng na kiangah kihoupihna puanin kongkhak bulah a hongkikhop vek ding uh ahi.
english: When they blow them, all the congregation shall gather themselves to you at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Huan, khat lel a mut uleh Israel mipite heutu intekpente kia na kianga a honpai khawm ding uh ahi ding.
english: If they blow just one, then the princes, the heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves to you.

paite: Huan, gallau muta na mut uleh suahlam panga omte a pawt ding uh ahi ding,
english: When you blow an alarm, the camps that lie on the east side shall go forward.

paite: Huan, gallau muta na mut nawm uleh simlam panga omte a pawt ding uh ahi; a pawtna ding un gallau mut banga a mut ding uh ahi.
english: When you blow an alarm the second time, the camps that lie on the south side shall go forward. They shall blow an alarm for their journeys.

paite: Ahihhangin mipite hongpai khawmna dingin na mut peuhmah ding ua, gallau muta bel mut louin.
english: But when the assembly is to be gathered together, you shall blow, but you shall not sound an alarm.

paite: Aron tapa siamputen pengkul a mut ding uh ahi; huai nou dingin na suante uh tana khantawn dan ding ahi ding hi.
english: “The sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow the trumpets. This shall be to you for a statute forever throughout your generations.

paite: Na gam ua melma nou honnuaisiahte dou dinga na kuan chiang un gallau mutin pengkulte na mut ding uh ahi; huchiin TOUPAN na Pathian ma uah theihgige na hi ding uh, na melmate uh lakah humbit na hi ding uh.
english: When you go to war in your land against the adversary who oppresses you, then you shall sound an alarm with the trumpets. Then you will be remembered before Yahweh your God, and you will be saved from your enemies.

paite: Nuam na sak ni te un, a hunbia na ankuangluinate uah, na kha thakte uah na halmang thillat uahte leh na kilemna thillat kithoihnate uah pengkul na mut ding uh ahi; huchiin na Pathian ma uah noua dingin theihgigena ahi ding: kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, chiin.
english: “Also in the day of your gladness, and in your set feasts, and in the beginnings of your months, you shall blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; and they shall be to you for a memorial before your God. I am Yahweh your God.”

paite: Huah, kum nihna kha nihna, huai kha ni sawmnih niin, hichi ahi, meipi meipi theihsakna biakbuk tung apat a tungkah sangta hi.
english: It happened in the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth day of the month, that the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle of the testimony.

paite: Huchiin Israel suante a paidan uh dungjuiin Sinai gamdai akipana a pawt uh; huan Paran gamdai ah meipi a khawlta.
english: The children of Israel went forward according to their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud stayed in the wilderness of Paran.

paite: Mosi zanga TOUPA thupiak bangin a pawt phot ua.
english: They first went forward according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.

paite: A masapenin Juda pawlte a pawl uh tamdan dungjui jelin a pawt ua: a heutu Aminadab tapa Nason ahi.
english: First, the standard of the camp of the children of Judah went forward according to their armies. Nahshon the son of Amminadab was over his army.

paite: Isakarte heutu zuar tapa Nethanel ahi.
english: Nethanel the son of Zuar was over the army of the tribe of the children of Issachar.

paite: Zubulunte heute Helon tapa Eliab ahi.
english: Eliab the son of Helon was over the army of the tribe of the children of Zebulun.

paite: Huan, biakbuk a phel ua, Gerson tapa leh Merari tapa biakbuk zongmite a pawt ua,
english: The tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, who bore the tabernacle, went forward.

paite: Huan, Reubente a pawl uh tamdan dungjuiin a pawt ua: a heutu Seder tapa Elizur ahi.
english: The standard of the camp of Reuben went forward according to their armies. Elizur the son of Shedeur was over his army.

paite: Simeonte heutu Zurisadai tapa Selumiel ahi.
english: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai was over the army of the tribe of the children of Simeon.

paite: Gadte heute Deuel tapa Eliasaph ahi.
english: Eliasaph the son of Deuel was over the army of the tribe of the children of Gad.

paite: Huan, Kohathten mun siangthou a zong ua, a pawt uh: huan a dangten a tun tak un biakbuk a nalam ua.
english: The Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary. The others set up the tabernacle before they arrived.

paite: Ephraimte a pawl uh tamdan dungjuiin a pawt ua: a heutu Emihud tapa Elisam ahi.
english: The standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies. Elishama the son of Ammihud was over his army.

paite: Manasete heutu Pedazur tapa Gamaliel ahi.
english: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur was over the army of the tribe of the children of Manasseh.

paite: Benjaminte heutu Gideoni tapa Abidan ahi.
english: Abidan the son of Gideoni was over the army of the tribe of the children of Benjamin.

paite: Huan, a nanungpenin Dante a pawl uh tamdan dungjuiin a pawt uh: a heutu Amisadai tapa Ahiezer ahi.
english: The standard of the camp of the children of Dan, which was the rear guard of all the camps, set forward according to their armies. Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai was over his army.

paite: Aserte heute Okran tapa Pagiel ahi.
english: Pagiel the son of Ochran was over the army of the tribe of the children of Asher.

paite: Naphtalite heute Enan tapa Ahir ahi.
english: Ahira the son of Enan was over the army of the tribe of the children of Naphtali.

paite: Huchibang ahi Israel suante a pawl uh tamdan dungjuia a paidan uh; huchibang takin a pawtta uh.
english: Thus were the travels of the children of Israel according to their armies; and they went forward.

paite: Huan, Mosi sungpa Midianmi Reuel tapa Hobab kiangah, Mosiin, Kon pe ding, TOUPAN a chihna munah ka hoh sin ua, ka kiang uah hong sam inla, hoihtakin na tungah ka hih ding uh: TOUPAN Israel suante tungtang thu lah hoihtakin a genta ngala, a chi a.
english: Moses said to Hobab, the son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses’ father-in-law, “We are journeying to the place of which Yahweh said, ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us, and we will treat you well; for Yahweh has spoken good concerning Israel.”

paite: Aman a kingah, Ka hong dah mai ding, kou gama ah ka tanaute kiangah ka pai zo mai ding, a chi.
english: He said to him, “I will not go; but I will depart to my own land, and to my relatives.”

paite: Huan, aman, Hongpai san mahmah ken, gamdai ah lah giahbuk satna ding na thei zo ngala, kou dingin mit na honghi ding hi.
english: He said, “Don’t leave us, please; because you know how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and you can be our eyes.

paite: Huan, hichi ahi dinga, ka kiang ua na hong tei aleh, ahi, hichi ahi dinga, TOUPAN thil hoih hohhihsak bangjelin ka honhihsak sam jel ding uhi, a chi a,
english: It shall be, if you go with us, yes, it shall be, that whatever good Yahweh does to us, we will do the same to you.”

paite: Huchiin TOUPA tang akipana ni thum lamah a pai uh; huan, TOUPA thukhun bawm amau adinga kingakna mun lem zongin a ma uah ni thum lam ah a na pai masa.
english: They set forward from the Mount of Yahweh three days’ journey. The ark of the covenant of Yahweh went before them three days’ journey, to seek out a resting place for them.

paite: A buk ua kipan a pawt un TOUPA meipi sunin a tunguah a om jel hi.
english: The cloud of Yahweh was over them by day, when they set forward from the camp.

paite: Huan, hichi ahia, huai bawm a pawt sin peuhmah chiangin Mosiin, TOUPA aw, hongkisa inla, na melmate hawljak inla, nang honhote na maah taikek uhen, a chi jel a.Huan, a kingakna peuhin, TOUPA aw Israel mipite kiangah hongkik nawnin, a chi jel uhi.
english: It happened, when the ark went forward, that Moses said, “Rise up, Yahweh, and let your enemies be scattered! Let those who hate you flee before you!”

paite: Huan, a kingakna peuhin, TOUPA aw Israel mipite kiangah hongkik nawnin, a chi jel uhi.
english: When it rested, he said, “Return, Yahweh, to the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel.”
